sa snying bsang mchod bzhugs so// slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir sa bdag bsang mchod 'dod na bzang shing tshogs tshad dud pa'i bsang dang gser skyems dar zab/ dkar gsum mngar gsum/ bzang drug dang*/ zho phud/ chang phud/ ja phud 'bru sna phye mar la sogs mchod tshogs 'du byas nas/ rang nyid gu rur gsal ba de yi ngang nas 'di skad do// kyai/ srid pa chags nas sa yi bdag /sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang*// sa bdag dbang chen lto 'phye dang*// sa la dbang ba'i lha rnams dang*/ khyad par yul 'di'i sa bdag dang*// sa bdag ri bdag chu yi bdag /shing bdag brag bdag lam gyi bdag /nyin srib phu mda' g.yas dang g.yon// phar ri tshur ri la gnas dang*/ khyad par sa skor sa mig 'dir// gnas pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan dang*// gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad bsang*// yul lha sa bdag klu gnyan rnams// skad cig nyid la 'dir gshegs la// rang rang mos pa'i gdan la bzhugs// sa bdag lha klu gnyan dga' ba// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul// rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// dkar gsum mngar gsum mchod pa dang*// bzang drug rtsi sman mthun pa'i rdzas// gser skyems dar zab sna tshogs dang*// ja phud chang phud 'o phud dang*// phye mar bzang shing dud pa dang*// shel tshigs khri dkar stong nag dang*// rta brgya gnag stong be'u lug khri// g.yag lug ra gsum gzugs 'gros dang*// mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs kun// ting 'dzin sngags kyis byin brlabs pa'i// 'di 'dra'i bsang mchod ngo mtshar can// lha klu sa bdag thams cad la// 'bul lo mchod do bsang ngo brngan/ khyed rnams mnyes shing tshims gyur cig /sngags 'chang bdag gi tshig la gson/ khyed kyi pho brang gnas mal du// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis// ma shes pa yi dbang gis las// sa gnyan brkos pa ma mchis so// gal te mchis na zhi bas bsdum// phye mar dkar gsum mchod pas bsang*// rdo gnyan rlogs pa ma mchis so// gal te mchis na zhi bas bsdum// phye mar dkar gsum dud pas bsang*// ri rab rtse nas ku btab dang*// rdzing chu yur bar drangs pa dang*// chu mig gnyan po bsubs pa dang*// ri la me chen shor ba dang*// gnyan sha bsad dang ri dwags bsad// pho brang gnas khang bshig pa dang*// gnyan sar sha khrag 'thor ba dang*// dkar dmar thab dang chu thab shor// pho brang mig du nyal ba dang*// gnyan sar gcer bur bud pa dang*// yengs ma lam la phaṭa sgra dang*// nub mo me 'od ldang ba dang*// gnyan sar rlan chen phos pa dang*// sa yi mig tu me bus dang*// sa gnyan phed dang khang las byas// rbab rgod gnyan po bsgril pa dang*// yul lha gnyan la phog pa dang*// sa gnyan ri gnyan thams cad la// 'jor gyis brkos dang thang btsugs pa// brgyal dang 'bog dang slong ba dang*// smas dang lhas sa phog pa dang*// 'grams 'khrugs 'gal ba byung gyur na// rtsi sman sna tshogs tshang bas bsang*// dar zab sman sna tshang bas bsang*// ja chang 'o phud tshang bas bsang*// bzang shing sna tshogs tshang bas bsang*// rnal 'byor dag pa'i sems kyis bsang*// ye shes lha yi thugs rjes bsang*// sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin rlabs kyis// 'grams pa yod na zhi gyur cig

/phog thug 'grams 'khrugs zhi gyur cig /khros pa yod na zhi gyur cig /'khon 'gras thams cad zhi gyur cig /ko long che ba'i sa bdag klu// 'dir gnas sa bdag klu btsan la// lus kyis gus btud ngag gis gsol// yid kyis g.yo sgyu med par bshags// zas phud rin chen mchod rdzas 'bul// sa rdo shing la rin tshab 'bul// go ba'i gtam dang bden pa'i tshig /sa 'dir bya ba gang bsgrub pa// sa la nga'i sa ma zer cig /rdo la nga'i rdo ma zer cig /shing la nga'i shing ma zer cig /chu la nga'i chu ma zer cig /phog thug 'gal ba byung na yang*// bzod pa dam pa mdzad du gsol// gdug rtsub bsam ngan kun spongs la// byams pa'i sems dang ldan par mdzod// bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung bar shog /oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a bi la maṇḍal la shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ 'grams 'khrugs bcos pa ci mang brjod/ yig brgya dang dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po'ang brjod/ rā ga a syes thun mtshams su bris pa dge'o/// / 1$0000250༄༅// bsang yig 'dod don lhun grub bzhugs so// 1$0000300oṃ/ lha mi'i phan bde longs spyod rgyas// zas nor gter dang bdud rtsi 'byung*// tshe ring nad med dgra rgol gzhom// thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur// gnas gtsang dkyil 'khor bya ba dang*/ khrus gtsang gos gsar gyon byas nas// sku gsum rnam dag rten drung 'dug /spos dang me tog kha zas mchod// rnal 'byor dam tshig gtsang na 'grub// 'di ni sa yi lha mos bdag padma la dngos su gsungs pas byin rlabs che 'o// mchod gsol sgrub pa'i skabs su bya'o// kyai/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// gtso mo lha mo brtan ma dang*// gnas 'dir rten bcas sa bdag klu// gzhan yang sa 'og sa steng dang*// sa bla chen po'i sa bdag dang*// yul lha klu gnyan ma lus rnams// sgrub pa po yis spyan 'dren no// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// padma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol/

khyed rnams rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan// rgya mtsho chu klung ri brag nags// bar snang sa gzhi kun gyi bdag /bzang ngan gnyis kyi shan thang 'byed// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa skyong*// 'gro ba mi dang lhan cig gnas// 'dir byon dkar mngar mchod pa bzhes// sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol/ khyad par sa phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i// sa bdag klu gnyan 'khor bcas rnams// 'dir byon mngar gsum mchod pa bzhes// sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol// stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// srid gsum 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa// 'dzam gling gling bzhi'i sa bdag klu// rgya gar rgya nag hor dang 'jang*// bal yul li yul bod khams yul// sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang*// sa bdag sa 'dzin klu chen brgyad// 'byung lnga'i lha mo sman mo dang*// ma mo brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*// 'khor gyi ma yams brtan ma'i tshogs// bod kyi mgur lha bcu gsum dang*// pho lha dgra bla gnyan po dang*// yul 'di'i gzhi bdag bcas pa la// 'bras dkar g.yag lug ra gsum 'bul// sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol// smyug rgod dar sna'i mchod pa 'bul// sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol// phye mar gser g.yu'i mchod pa 'bul// sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol// mda' dar bal tshon mchod pa 'bul// sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol// 'brang rgyas chang phud 'o ma 'bul// sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol// shug pa mkhan dkar sur dkar gyi// bsang chen dud pa'i mchod pa 'bul// sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol// gzhi bdag khyed rnams spyan lam du// mkho dgu ci 'dod ldan gyur cig /khyed rnams ci 'dod tshims gyur cig /sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol// sngon tshe gzhi bdag khyed rnams kyis// slob dpon padma'i spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa po'i// bsam pa yid bzhin myur du sgrubs// 'dod pa'i dngos grub myur du stsol// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

ces 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ nangs mo rtag tu bsang 'di gtang bas 'dod don lhun gyis grub cing yul phyogs bkra shis bde legs su 'gyur ro// /// / 1$0000250༄༅// gnam chos sa bdag 'khrugs bcos kyi lhan thabs shing rtsi 'bul ba ni/ 1$0000300 shar gyi shing rtsi gzung la/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ khyad par dam rdzas bdud rtsi shing rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul ba'i gnas ni/ shar shing khams rgyal po la sogs pa/ sa bdag the se rā hu la/ spar kha zin/ sme ba gsum mthing*/ lo stag yos la 'khor ba'i sa bdag /zla ba zhag dang dus tshod la 'khor ba'i sa bdag rgyal po blon po/ khyad par du de ring gi tshes grangs 'di la rgyu ba'i sa bdag klu gnyan rnams la shing rtsi 'bru sna bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di phul bas/ phog thug 'grams 'khrugs gang byung ba thams cad bshags shing*/ thugs zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig / shar du 'bul/ lho yi shing rtsi gzung la/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ khyad par dam rdzas bdud rtsi shing rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul ba'i gnas ni/ lho me khams rgyal po la sogs pa/ sa bdag the se rā hu la/ spar kha li/ sme ba dgu dmar/ lo rta sbrul la 'khor ba'i sa bdag /zla ba zhag dang dus tshod la 'khor ba'i sa bdag rgyal po blon po/ khyad par du de ring gi tshes grangs 'di la rgyu ba'i sa bdag klu gnyan rnams la shing rtsi 'bru sna bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di phul bas/ phog thug 'grams 'khrugs gang byung ba thams cad bshags shing*/ thugs zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig / lho ru 'bul/ nub kyi shing rtsi gzung la/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ khyad par dam rdzas bdud rtsi shing rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul ba'i gnas ni/ nub lcags khams rgyal po la sogs pa/ sa bdag the se rā hu la/ spar kha dwa/ sme ba bdun dmar/

lo bya sprel la 'khor ba'i sa bdag /zla ba zhag dang dus tshod la 'khor ba'i sa bdag rgyal po blon po/ khyad par du de ring gi tshes grangs 'di la rgyu ba'i sa bdag klu gnyan rnams la shing rtsi 'bru sna bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di phul bas/ phog thug 'grams 'khrugs gang byung ba thams cad bshags shing*/ thugs zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig / nub tu 'bul/ byang gi shing rtsi gzung la/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ khyad par dam rdzas bdud rtsi shing rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul ba'i gnas ni/ byang chu khams rgyal po la sogs pa/ sa bdag the se rā hu la/ spar kha khams/ sme ba gcig dkar/ lo byi phag la 'khor ba'i sa bdag /zla ba zhag dang dus tshod la 'khor ba'i sa bdag rgyal po blon po/ khyad par du de ring gi tshes grangs 'di la rgyu ba'i sa bdag klu gnyan rnams la shing rtsi 'bru sna bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di phul bas/ phog thug 'grams 'khrugs gang byung ba thams cad bshags shing*/ thugs zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig / byang du 'bul/ shar lho'i shing rtsi gzung la/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ khyad par dam rdzas bdud rtsi shing rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul ba'i gnas ni/ shar lho rlung lha'i rgyal po la sogs pa/ sa bdag the se rā hu la/ spar kha zon/ sme ba bzhi ljang*/ lo 'brug la 'khor ba'i sa bdag /zla ba zhag dang dus tshod la 'khor ba'i sa bdag rgyal po blon po/ khyad par du de ring gi tshes grangs 'di la rgyu ba'i sa bdag klu gnyan rnams la shing rtsi 'bru sna bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di phul bas/ phog thug 'grams 'khrugs gang byung ba thams cad bshags shing*/ thugs zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig / shar lhor 'bul/ lho nub kyi shing rtsi gzung la/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ khyad par dam rdzas bdud rtsi shing rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul ba'i gnas ni/

lho nub sa khams rgyal po la sogs pa/ sa bdag the se rā hu la/ spar kha khon/ sme ba gnyis nag /lo lug la 'khor ba'i sa bdag /zla ba zhag dang dus tshod la 'khor ba'i sa bdag rgyal po blon po/ khyad par du de ring gi tshes grangs 'di la rgyu ba'i sa bdag klu gnyan rnams la shing rtsi 'bru sna bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di phul bas/ phog thug 'grams 'khrugs gang byung ba thams cad bshags shing*/ thugs zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig / lho nub tu 'bul/ nub byang shing rtsi gzung la/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ khyad par dam rdzas bdud rtsi shing rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul ba'i gnas ni/ nub byang gnam dbang gi rgyal po la sogs pa/ sa bdag the se rā hu la/ spar kha khen/ sme ba drug dkar/ lo khyi la 'khor ba'i sa bdag /zla ba zhag dang sogs kyis nub byang du 'bul/ byang shar shing rtsi gzung la/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ khyad par dam rdzas bdud rtsi shing rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul ba'i gnas ni/ byang shar ri dbang gi rgyal po la sogs pa/ sa bdag the se rā hu la/ spar kha gin/ sme ba brgyad dkar/ lo glang la 'khor ba'i sa bdag /zla ba zhag dang dus tshod la 'khor ba'i sa bdag rgyal po blon po/ khyad par du de ring gi tshes grangs 'di la rgyu ba'i sa bdag klu gnyan rnams la shing rtsi 'bru sna bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di phul bas/ phog thug 'grams 'khrugs gang byung ba thams cad bshags shing*/ thugs zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig / byang shar du 'bul/ dbus kyi shing rtsi gzung la/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa kyis chu gtsang bran la/ oṃ kṣiṃ hi rā dza pri thi de wī sarba bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi/ khyad par dam rdzas bdud rtsi shing rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul ba'i gnas ni/ sems dpa' sa yi snying po// sa yi lha mo brtan ma/ dbang chen shrī bha dra/

sa 'dzin lag pa chen po// lto 'phye chen po klu brgyad/ 'byung ba spar sme/ lo dang zla ba'i sa bdag rgyal blon bcu bdun la sogs pa srid pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan kun la 'bul lo/ khyad par du yul phyogs 'di yi yul bdag ri bdag brag bdag chu bdag rdo bdag shing bdag gnas bdag /khyim lha phugs lha/ gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la mchod sbyin gtor ma shing rtsi 'bru sna 'di 'bul lo// thams cad mnyes shing tshims par gyur cig / ces pas dbul/ mchod dang bstod bshags gshegs bsdu gzhung ltar ro// zhes pa'ang rā ga a syas sbyar ba'o/// /
